scope: 30 topics, 68 descriptions, 272 complete instruments; PDF296–299 columns and continuation reviewed visually
method: Read complete rubric views in sequential blocks, including scientific relations, all progression descriptors and absence of extra tasks. Inspected checklist, achievement scale and partial-credit transformations for cell explanation; automatic format, parity and scoring contracts supplement the review.
corrections: Provided images/models do not require making representations
Cell explanation separates parts and functions without requiring drawings or labels
ADN-only and ARN-only tasks keep their scope
Mendel historical contributions do not imply solving crosses
Qualitative hereditary exercises do not impose numerical calculations
Ordering stages has an explicit sequence criterion
Recorded and provided data are distinguished
Energy flow does not duplicate a general ecosystem dimension
Basic immune function does not impose a disease case
Drawing or model remains an alternative
limits: Defined deterministic wording patterns, not every possible wording
General comparison criteria use the requested scientific characteristics without prescribing a new comparison table
Full visual editor verification is separate and recorded in the grade report
Health examples use provided sources or fictitious cases, never personal diagnoses or prescriptions
